criteria.requirement: Implement bibtexparser.pages.NormalizePages as an opt-in non-mutating BlockMiddleware. Normalize complete ascending numeric page ranges separated by commas from hyphen/en-dash/em-dash to BibTeX double hyphens, preserving digit text and first original_pages metadata. Leave electronic/single/Roman/decimal/descending or mixed unknown formats wholly unchanged. Modify only pages, preserve other fields and default stacks, and remain idempotent.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
